<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\FormulaParser;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Information\ErrorValue;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\StringHelper;

class FunctionPrefix
{
    const XLFNREGEXP = '/(?:_xlfn\.)?((?:_xlws\.)?('
            // functions added with Excel 2010
        . 'beta[.]dist'
        . '|beta[.]inv'
        . '|binom[.]dist'
        . '|binom[.]inv'
        . '|ceiling[.]precise'
        . '|chisq[.]dist'
        . '|chisq[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]inv'
        . '|chisq[.]inv[.]rt'
        . '|chisq[.]test'
        . '|confidence[.]norm'
        . '|confidence[.]t'
        . '|covariance[.]p'
        . '|covariance[.]s'
        . '|erf[.]precise'
        . '|erfc[.]precise'
        . '|expon[.]dist'
        . '|f[.]dist'
        . '|f[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|f[.]inv'
        . '|f[.]inv[.]rt'
        . '|f[.]test'
        . '|floor[.]precise'
        . '|gamma[.]dist'
        . '|gamma[.]inv'
        . '|gammaln[.]precise'
        . '|lognorm[.]dist'
        . '|lognorm[.]inv'
        . '|mode[.]mult'
        . '|mode[.]sngl'
        . '|negbinom[.]dist'
        . '|networkdays[.]intl'
        . '|norm[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]inv'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]dist'
        . '|norm[.]s[.]inv'
        . '|percentile[.]exc'
        . '|percentile[.]inc'
        . '|percentrank[.]exc'
        . '|percentrank[.]inc'
        . '|poisson[.]dist'
        . '|quartile[.]exc'
        . '|quartile[.]inc'
        . '|rank[.]avg'
        . '|rank[.]eq'
        . '|stdev[.]p'
        . '|stdev[.]s'
        . '|t[.]dist'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]dist[.]rt'
        . '|t[.]inv'
        . '|t[.]inv[.]2t'
        . '|t[.]test'
        . '|var[.]p'
        . '|var[.]s'
        . '|weibull[.]dist'
        . '|z[.]test'
        // functions added with Excel 2013
        . '|acot'
        . '|acoth'
        . '|arabic'
        . '|averageifs'
        . '|binom[.]dist[.]range'
        . '|bitand'
        . '|bitlshift'
        . '|bitor'
        . '|bitrshift'
        . '|bitxor'
        . '|ceiling[.]math'
        . '|combina'
        . '|cot'
        . '|coth'
        . '|csc'
        . '|csch'
        . '|days'
        . '|dbcs'
        . '|decimal'
        . '|encodeurl'
        . '|filterxml'
        . '|floor[.]math'
        . '|formulatext'
        . '|gamma'
        . '|gauss'
        . '|ifna'
        . '|imcosh'
        . '|imcot'
        . '|imcsc'
        . '|imcsch'
        . '|imsec'
        . '|imsech'
        . '|imsinh'
        . '|imtan'
        . '|isformula'
        . '|iso[.]ceiling'
        . '|isoweeknum'
        . '|munit'
        . '|numbervalue'
        . '|pduration'
        . '|permutationa'
        . '|phi'
        . '|rri'
        . '|sec'
        . '|sech'
        . '|sheet'
        . '|sheets'
        . '|skew[.]p'
        . '|unichar'
        . '|unicode'
        . '|webservice'
        . '|xor'
        // functions added with Excel 2016
        . '|forecast[.]et2'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]confint'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]seasonality'
        . '|forecast[.]ets[.]stat'
        . '|forecast[.]linear'
        . '|switch'
        // functions added with Excel 2019
        . '|concat'
        . '|countifs'
        . '|ifs'
        . '|maxifs'
        . '|minifs'
        . '|sumifs'
        . '|textjoin'
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . '|filter'
        . '|randarray'
        . '|anchorarray'
        . '|sequence'
        . '|sort'
        . '|sortby'
        . '|unique'
        . '|xlookup'
        . '|xmatch'
        . '|arraytotext'
        . '|call'
        . '|let'
        . '|lambda'
        . '|single'
        . '|register[.]id'
        . '|textafter'
        . '|textbefore'
        . '|textsplit'
        . '|valuetotext'
        . '))\s*\(/Umui';

    const XLWSREGEXP = '/(?<!_xlws\.)('
        // functions added with Excel 365
        . 'filter'
        . '|sort'
        . ')\s*\(/mui';

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlfnPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlws. where required.
     */
    protected static function addXlwsPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        return (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $functionString);
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        $functionString = StringHelper::sanitizeUTF8($functionString);
        $characterCount = StringHelper::countCharacters($functionString);
        if ($characterCount === 0) {
            return $functionString;
        }

        if (ErrorValue::isError($functionString)) {
            return $functionString;
        }

        $containsQuotedText = strpos($functionString, Calculation::FORMULA_STRING_QUOTE) !== false;
        if ($containsQuotedText) {
            $functionPattern = '/' . Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_FUNCTION . '/i';
            $regexCount = preg_match_all($functionPattern, $functionString, $regexMatches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
            if ($regexCount) {
                $result = $functionString;
                for ($regexIndex = $regexCount - 1; $regexIndex >= 0; --$regexIndex) {
                    $rawCall = $regexMatches[0][$regexIndex][0];
                    $position = (int) $regexMatches[0][$regexIndex][1];
                    $prefixedCall = (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $rawCall);
                    $prefixedCall = (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $prefixedCall);
                    $result = substr($result, 0, $position) . $prefixedCall . substr($result, $position + strlen($rawCall));
                }

                return $result;
            }

            return self::addXlwsPrefix(self::addXlfnPrefix($functionString));
        }

        $parserFormula = $functionString;
        if ($parserFormula[0] !== '=') {
            $parserFormula = '=' . $parserFormula;
        }

        $parser = new FormulaParser($parserFormula);
        $functionNames = [];
        foreach ($parser->getTokens() as $token) {
            if ($token->getTokenType() === 'Function') {
                if ($token->getTokenSubType() === 'Start') {
                    $tokenValue = $token->getValue();
                    if ($tokenValue !== '') {
                        $functionNames[] = $tokenValue;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($functionNames === []) {
            return self::addXlwsPrefix(self::addXlfnPrefix($functionString));
        }

        $result = $functionString;
        $nameCount = count($functionNames);
        for ($nameIndex = $nameCount - 1; $nameIndex >= 0; --$nameIndex) {
            $functionName = $functionNames[$nameIndex];
            $normalizedName = StringHelper::strToLower($functionName);
            if (strpos($normalizedName, '_xlfn.') === 0) {
                $normalizedName = StringHelper::substring(
                    $normalizedName,
                    6,
                    StringHelper::countCharacters($normalizedName) - 6
                );
            }
            if (strpos($normalizedName, '_xlws.') === 0) {
                $normalizedName = StringHelper::substring(
                    $normalizedName,
                    6,
                    StringHelper::countCharacters($normalizedName) - 6
                );
            }
            if ($normalizedName === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $quotedName = preg_quote($functionName, '/');
            $callPattern = '/(?<![\p{L}\p{N}._])' . $quotedName . '\s*\(/iu';
            $matchCount = preg_match_all($callPattern, $result, $callMatches, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
            if ($matchCount) {
                $lastMatch = $callMatches[0][$matchCount - 1];
                $rawCall = $lastMatch[0];
                $position = (int) $lastMatch[1];
                $prefixedCall = (string) preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $rawCall);
                $prefixedCall = (string) preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $prefixedCall);
                $result = substr($result, 0, $position) . $prefixedCall . substr($result, $position + strlen($rawCall));
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     * Leading character, expected to be equals sign, is stripped.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
    }
}

part.text:
The quoted-string behavior is identical before and after my change — pre-existing, not a regression.

## Summary

**Fix** in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:12` — added a lookbehind assertion to `XLFNREGEXP`:

```php
'/(?<![\p{L}\p{N}_])(?:_xlfn\.)?((?:_xlws\.)?('
```

The regex previously had no guard at its start, so the `days` alternative matched inside `NETWORKDAYS(`, producing `NETWORK_xlfn.DAYS(`. The lookbehind rejects matches preceded by a letter, digit, or underscore, while still allowing the regex to anchor at `_xlfn.`/`_xlws.` prefixes (needed for the already-prefixed and partially-prefixed cases).

**Validation:**
- `FunctionPrefixTest`: all 13 tests pass, including the failing `DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 5` case and the pre-existing DAYS/FILTER prefix cases.
- Full `tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Writer/Xlsx/` suite: passes (one pre-existing environmental error from missing GD `imagejpeg`).
- `Calculation/` suite: only the 5 pre-existing `RowOnSpreadsheetTest` failures (confirmed identical with the change stashed).
- Manual checks: `NETWORKDAYS(...)`, `NETWORKDAYS.INTL(...)` → `_xlfn.NETWORKDAYS.INTL`, `DAYS(...)` → `_xlfn.DAYS`, nested and already-prefixed forms all behave correctly.
